claims.answer: Main-process workflow and Buddy schedulers retain trigger times and limit overlapping runs. Workflows support command, wait and approval conditions with guarded retries. Buddy recurrence has a 15-minute minimum and heartbeat is disabled by default. Buddy can run without a particular window while the app stays open; workflow agent steps require an active workspace/window. Quitting ends the runtime. No external Git webhook service is established.
